name: Remote
description: Remote is a global employment platform offering Employer of Record (EOR), global payroll, Contractor of Record, and contractor management, with Remote stating it owns and operates 100% of its own local legal entities in the countries where it hires rather than handing off to third-party partners.
best_for: Companies hiring employees or contractors in other countries that want a global employment provider with published self-serve monthly pricing and its own owned local entities rather than third-party EOR partners.
features: Employer of Record (EOR): hire without opening a local entity in 90+ countries
Global Payroll for compliant payroll processing in countries where the company already has its own entity
Contractor of Record (COR) for compliant management of international contractors
Contractor Management for onboarding and paying contractors in their own currency, with conversion of contractors to full-time employees
Professional Employer Organization (PEO) for U.S. hiring administration
Equity management for granting and administering equity to global team members
Remote IP Guard for IP-ownership protection in countries with weak default IP-assignment laws
API, webhooks, and CLI for integrating employment data into internal systems
Built-in 2FA and SSO for account security
pros: Publishes exact self-serve monthly pricing for EOR, Global Payroll, and Contractor Management rather than requiring a quote just to see a price
States it owns and operates 100% of its own local entities rather than handing off to third-party partners in-country
ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 compliant, and CSA STAR Level 1 accredited, per its security and compliance page
cons: Contractor of Record, PEO, and Equity are shown only as 'from' floor prices, so the real quote needs a sales conversation
Global Payroll's per-employee price excludes a separate, undisclosed recurring payroll delivery fee and an entity-setup implementation fee

tiers.name: Global Payroll

alternatives.name: Deel
alternatives.description: A global people platform for hiring, paying, and managing contractors and employees across borders, combining EOR, PEO, contractor payments, global payroll, and HR under one contract.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting EOR and contractor payments bundled with HR and IT device management on a single platform.

alternatives.name: Papaya Global
alternatives.description: A global workforce payments platform offering EOR, Contractor of Record, and global payroll, aimed at enterprises and unifying HRIS/ERP/VMS data through an AI data layer.
alternatives.best_for: Larger enterprises that want AI-driven data unification across existing HRIS/ERP/VMS systems alongside EOR and payroll.
strengths: Published starting prices for EOR and payroll
